rule: Region flag threshold: a joint/region rated >= 3 on the 1-5 check-in scale
summary: On a 1-5 scale, 3 is the first 'moderate' level, broadly comparable to an OSTRC 'moderate' problem, and well below the ~2.8-NRS-point worsening that marks a self-reported LBP flare. No validation of a 1-5 joint item exists; the threshold is a sensible conservative heuristic consistent with joint_yellow.

sources.note: OSTRC weekly questionnaire (knee/low back/shoulder): repeated self-report captures far more overuse problems than time-loss reporting
Self-reported LBP flare associated with ~2.8 NRS points higher pain, more interference and analgesic use (11,817 surveys)
Saw 2016 SR (56 studies): subjective self-report measures track training load more sensitively than objective markers
